part: Lower bulkhead (gear box lower half) of the Carten T410R, stock part NBA249, model version 1
coordinate_system: Origin at the centre of the 4 bottom holes on the bottom face. x along the diff axis (across the car), y along the pinion axis, +y toward the pinion and the centre shaft, z = 0 bottom face (contact face to the chassis plate), +z up.

source_codes.plate: Hole pattern of the chassis plate v2 (H03 to H06 and H28 to H31), confirmed by the test print
source_codes.manual: T410R instruction manual (bearing sizes, screw sizes)
source_codes.user: Information from the owner of the car
source_codes.photo: Estimate from photos of the stock part with a ruler, accuracy approx. +-1 mm, to be replaced by caliper measurements
source_codes.design: Design choice of the model, free

bottom_hole_dx.note: Spacing of the bottom holes across (x). Plate: H03-H04 28.16, H05-H06 28.18, H28-H29 28.14, H30-H31 28.12. The photo of the bottom face agrees within approx. 1 %.

bottom_hole_dy.note: Spacing of the bottom holes along (y). Plate: H03-H05 20.22, H28-H30 20.19.

bottom_hole_d.note: Tap drill for M3. The screws are M3x8 countersunk from below through the 2 mm plate, so 6 mm of the screw engage in the part.

bottom_hole_depth.note: Drill depth. Thread depth for CNC: 6.5.

axis_z.note: Height of the parting face above the bottom face. The diff axis and the pinion axis lie in the parting face (half bores).

diff_axis_y.note: Position of the diff axis in y, offset toward the pinion.

body_half_width.note: Half width in x: outer faces of the diff bearing walls.

body_y_outer_end.note: Outer end of the body at the parting face (side without pinion).

body_y_pinion_end.note: Pinion end of the body at the parting face, without the pinion housing.

body_corner_r.note: Corner radius of the outline at the parting face (top view).

base_half_length.note: Half length in y of the narrow lower section between the pivot blocks.

base_height_pinion_side.note: Height of the narrow lower section on the pinion side, start of the flared wing.

base_height_outer_side.note: Height of the narrow lower section on the outer side.

wing_pinion_side.note: Side profile of the flared wing on the pinion side, points (y, z).

wing_outer_side.note: Side profile of the flared wing on the outer side, points (y, z).

cavity_r.note: Radius of the gear cavity around the diff axis (ring gear and diff case). The cavity ends at the floor.

cavity_half_length.note: Half length in x of the full-radius cavity.

cavity_hub_r.note: Radius of the cavity between the full-radius cavity and the bearing seats (diff case hubs and shims).

floor_z.note: Height of the cavity floor (floor thickness).

diff_bearing.note: Diff bearings NBA299, d x D x B.

diff_seat_inner_x.note: Inner face of the diff bearing seat (|x|). The seat is 4.0 mm wide and ends at the lip.

diff_lip_d.note: Opening of the outer lip that holds the diff bearing. Must be larger than the inner race of the bearing (approx. 11.6 mm).

pinion_bearing.note: Pinion bearings NBA298, d x D x B, 2 pieces.

pinion_seat_y_inner.note: Inner end of the pinion bearing seat (shoulder face).

pinion_seat_length.note: Length of the seat for 2 bearings of 4 mm plus 0.2 mm.

pinion_shoulder_t.note: Thickness of the shoulder in front of the inner pinion bearing.

pinion_shoulder_d.note: Opening of the shoulder: clearance for the shaft (5 mm) and the shims (5x7).

pinion_housing_r.note: Outer radius of the pinion housing.

pinion_pocket_r.note: Radius of the pocket for the pinion gear (17T).

pinion_pocket_y_min.note: Start of the pinion pocket in y.

top_boss_d.note: Outer diameter of the 4 bosses for the screws of the upper bulkhead.

top_boss_protrusion.note: Height of the bosses above the parting face.

top_boss_x.note: Position of the bosses in x (+-).

top_boss_y_pinion.note: Position of the 2 bosses on the pinion side (screws M3x10, button head).

top_boss_y_outer.note: Position of the 2 bosses on the outer side (screws M3x8, button head).

top_boss_z_base.note: Lower end of the boss columns below the wings.

top_hole_d.note: Tap drill for M3 (user: all screws M3).

top_hole_depth.note: Drill depth from the top of the bosses.

swaybar_hole_x.note: Position of the 2 sway bar mounting holes in x (+-). M3 screws (user).

swaybar_hole_y.note: Position of the sway bar mounting holes in y.

swaybar_tab_r.note: Outer radius of the tabs around the sway bar holes.

swaybar_tab_t.note: Thickness of the tabs. The top face of the tabs is the parting face.

print_seat_allowance.note: Test print only: added to the bearing seat diameters.

print_hole_d.note: Test print only: diameter of all M3 holes for self-tapping screws.
